stories.headline: Iran offers to reopen Hormuz in 7 days; WSJ reports Trump rejected it and plans strikes after midterms
stories.verification: Offer: Confirmed-primary (Araghchi public remarks). Rejection/post-midterm plan: Single-reliable-source (WSJ unnamed officials, relayed widely); no White House comment.
stories.one_line: Araghchi said Fri night Iran sent via mediators (reportedly to Witkoff) a plan: reopen Hormuz and resume nuclear talks within 7 days if the US lifts its port blockade, waives oil sanctions and observes a ceasefire incl. Lebanon. WSJ: Trump rejected it, expects to resume bombing after Nov 3 midterms, scale undecided.
stories.score_note: Answers the open 'big decision' question if accurate; ties oil/Hormuz to the political calendar.
